Composition rules

[04]

Preserve

  • Halibut at weight 20, fitted to width.
  • Pure white and a substantial black section.
  • Large vertical project presentations.
  • Mono metadata, tiny accent squares, fine rules.
  • Gray-green tags and varied image heights.

Avoid

  • A heavy sans hero or generic SaaS sections.
  • Rounded project images and elevated cards.
  • Glow, glass, and decorative gradients.
  • Rasterized text as the final implementation.
  • Presenting recommended motion as measured.

Readable source crops

[05]

Handoff and evidence

[06]

Give the whole package to your AI and use AI-HANDOFF.md as the instruction. FRAME.md is the design authority alongside the screenshots. Exact motion algorithms and small-screen rendering remain documented limits.

This guide is self-contained and works offline. The separate caption fragment uses the bundled assets folder. Source: soren-template.framer.website · Creator: Bryn Taylor · Inspected: October 6, 2026. This guide does not contain the editable Framer project.
